Before you play

This is an experimental game. Once it's live, nobody can change, pause or undo it, including us.

You buy parts with IMD and plug them into a shared machine. Your parts earn while the round lasts, and the last ten parts placed win the jackpot. Parts cost more as a round goes on, and fast players and bots compete for the jackpot at the end.

Only spend what you're fine losing.
